properties.name: Noor Ouarzazate Solar Complex
properties.description: Africa's largest concentrated solar power complex. Noor I–IV combine CSP parabolic trough, CSP tower, and PV technologies across 3,000 hectares in the Draa-Tafilalet region. The complex provides 3 hours of thermal storage, enabling dispatchable solar power after sunset — a critical capability for grid stability.

properties.name: Noor Midelt Phase I
properties.description: Morocco's most ambitious solar project — a hybrid CSP+PV plant with 5 hours of molten-salt storage. Located on the Moulouya plain at 1,500 m altitude. When complete, it will be the world's first utility-scale hybrid with this storage depth, delivering firm renewable power to ONEE around the clock.

properties.name: Noor Atlas (Tata) Solar PV
properties.description: Part of MASEN's rolling pipeline of utility-scale PV projects in the Souss-Draa corridor. The site benefits from among the highest GHI in Morocco (>2,400 kWh/m²/yr) with minimal grid upgrade requirements, sitting close to existing 225 kV infrastructure.
